answer: Why does a bond that loses value stop sybil attacks? Because hoarded identities bleed while honest ones refresh. A 120 copper bond bought at the admission gate locks for 10 epochs, loses 4% of value per epoch, and drops the identity below 60 units, downgraded. A nebula of idle bonds is easy to spot: only verified work restores face value. What does forgery cost? Half the remaining bond plus a 6-epoch freeze. What does a 1,000-clone farm lose? 120,000 units upfront, 4,800 per epoch in decay, over 40,000 in 10 epochs. At the nadir, the bond strands on the reef, worthless.
